stock.description: Lushang Life Services Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise specializing in comprehensive property management. The company's core services include diligent cleaning, robust security, meticulous greening, essential repair and maintenance, and the upkeep of public areas. These offerings cater to a diverse portfolio of properties, encompassing private residences, commercial complexes, corporate office buildings, apartment blocks, municipal roads, educational institutions, themed developments, healthcare facilities, financial institutions, industrial zones, and even aviation base properties. Lushang extends its expert management to property developers, individual owners, residents, and tenants alike. Beyond its fundamental management duties, the firm also provides bespoke value-added services to developers, such as architectural design, construction site supervision, sales office administration, strategic consulting, landscape development, pre-delivery preparations, and ongoing maintenance. Furthermore, Lushang offers a range of community-centric value-added services directly to property owners and residents, including the optimization of shared spaces and resources, parking facility management, utility oversight, and personalized waste removal and domestic assistance. Founded in 2006, Lushang Life Services Co., Ltd. is based in Jinan, China.
